test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 04 May 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
A sentence has been given with a blank to be filled with an appropriate option. Choose the correct alternative. 

Satya Nadella completed his primary education __________ Hyderabad Public School, Begumpet.
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 2'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• When referring to receiving an education at a particular institution, the correct preposition is** "from."**
 
• The sentence* "Satya Nadella completed his primary education from Hyderabad Public School, Begumpet" *is grammatically correct.

Therefore, the correct answer is- **'from'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Option 1 **"by"** is incorrect because it typically indicates means or method.
 
• Option 3 **"over"** and Option 4 **"onto"** are not suitable prepositions in this context.
